mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_campaign WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT FROM marketing_campaign WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM marketing_campaign WHERE status IN ('SCHEDULED','ONLINE') AND start_at <= #{now} AND end_at > #{now} ORDER BY sort_weight ASC, start_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT FROM marketing_campaign WHERE participation_mode='MERCHANT_ENROLL' AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','ONLINE') AND enroll_start_at IS NOT NULL AND enroll_end_at IS NOT NULL AND enroll_start_at <= #{now} AND enroll_end_at > #{now} ORDER BY sort_weight ASC, start_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_campaign SET name=#{name}, campaign_type=#{campaignType}, participation_mode=#{participationMode}, title=#{title}, subtitle=#{subtitle}, tag_code=#{tagCode}, tag_name=#{tagName}, cover_url=#{coverUrl}, city_codes=#{cityCodes}, service_category_codes=#{serviceCategoryCodes}, start_at=#{startAt}, end_at=#{endAt}, enroll_start_at=#{enrollStartAt}, enroll_end_at=#{enrollEndAt}, enrollment_quota=#{enrollmentQuota}, coupon_campaign_id=#{couponCampaignId}, sort_weight=#{sortWeight}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE marketing_campaign SET published_page_schema_json=page_schema_json, page_version=#{pageVersion}, status=#{toStatus}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{fromStatus} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND page_schema_json IS NOT NULL AND page_draft_version > 0
mapper.select: SELECT id,campaign_id,version,schema_json,published_by_type,published_by_id,published_at FROM marketing_page_version WHERE campaign_id=#{campaignId} ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM marketing_page_version WHERE campaign_id=#{campaignId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketing_campaign_store (id,campaign_id,merchant_id,store_id,source,status,offer_tag,offer_title,offer_copy, sort_weight,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{campaignId},#{merchantId},#{storeId},#{source},#{status},#{offerTag},#{offerTitle}, #{offerCopy},#{sortWeight},#{version},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE merchant_id=VALUES(merchant_id), source=VALUES(source), status=VALUES(status), offer_tag=VALUES(offer_tag), offer_title=VALUES(offer_title), offer_copy=VALUES(offer_copy), sort_weight=VALUES(sort_weight), version=version+1, updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_campaign_store WHERE campaign_id=#{campaignId} ORDER BY sort_weight ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketing_campaign_store WHERE campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT cs.id,cs.campaign_id,cs.merchant_id,cs.store_id,cs.source,cs.status, cs.offer_tag,cs.offer_title,cs.offer_copy,cs.sort_weight,cs.version, cs.created_at,cs.updated_at FROM marketing_campaign_store cs INNER JOIN marketing_campaign c ON c.id=cs.campaign_id WHERE cs.store_id=#{storeId} AND cs.status='ACTIVE' AND c.status IN ('SCHEDULED','ONLINE') AND c.start_at <= #{now} AND c.end_at > #{now} ORDER BY c.sort_weight ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT FROM marketing_placement p INNER JOIN marketing_campaign c ON c.id=p.campaign_id WHERE p.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM marketing_placement p INNER JOIN marketing_campaign c ON c.id=p.campaign_id WHERE p.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM marketing_placement p INNER JOIN marketing_campaign c ON c.id=p.campaign_id WHERE p.position_code=#{positionCode} AND p.status='ENABLED' AND p.start_at <= #{now} AND p.end_at > #{now} AND c.status IN ('SCHEDULED','ONLINE') AND c.start_at <= #{now} AND c.end_at > #{now} ORDER BY p.sort_weight ASC, p.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketing_placement WHERE position_code=#{positionCode} AND status='ENABLED' AND (city_code IS NULL OR city_code=#{cityCode}) AND start_at < #{now} AND end_at > #{now}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketing_placement WHERE position_code=#{positionCode} AND status='ENABLED'

SELECT FROM marketing_enrollment e INNER JOIN marketing_campaign c ON c.id=e.campaign_id WHERE e.campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND e.store_id=#{storeId}

SELECT id,content_type,bytes,width,height,sha256,object_key,content,status,created_by_id,created_at FROM marketing_asset WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
